title: Rule
description: A user-authored decision rule (ADR-0013). It is stored as the `rule` field of a card of type `rule`; the rule id is that card's id. `when` and `unless` are conditions over accepted cards on a Lage, card fields, edges or the user's own stances; `then` is the user's preferred action, shown verbatim, never combined into a recommendation.

when.description: All conditions must hold for the rule to fire.

then.description: The preferred action, as the user wrote it.

unless.description: If any of these conditions holds, the rule does not fire.

cardOnLage.title: CardOnLageCondition
cardOnLage.description: The card is placed on the Lage and accepted.

cardField.title: CardFieldCondition
cardField.description: A canonical card field equals a value: on `card` if given, otherwise on any accepted card placed on the Lage.

edgeExists.title: EdgeCondition
edgeExists.description: An accepted edge of this kind exists on the Lage, optionally restricted to its endpoints.

stance.title: StanceCondition
stance.description: The user's own stance on a card. Rules with such a condition are withheld from every non-screen target (ADR-0013).
